answer.justification: Only activation measurements were available. The relative L2 profile is 0.088 at layer 1, 0.179 at layer 8, 0.189 at layer 16, 0.203 at layer 24 and 0.252 at layer 32, which is flat in the middle layers and matches the quantized pattern. Final-layer cosine is 0.966 and the final-layer jump is +0.025, both in the quantized range. Effective rank of 4.17 (noise-like) and direction consistency of 0.516 also match quantized, while fine-tuned would show rank of 3.58 or lower and consistency of 0.618 or higher. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.969 is a shrink, which matches quantized (0.968) and rules out fine-tuned (above 1). The layer-2 spike of 0.8 is small, which rules out system-prompted (31.7 or more). The non-zero values rule out base. Layer 1 is 0.088, slightly below the quantized range, but every other feature fits.
